item.title: Samsung Magician disk utility takes 18 steps and two Recovery Mode reboots to uninstall
item.description: A disk utility with no uninstaller, 500 failed chown calls, an embedded Electron runtime, and four kernel extensions that survive sudo rm -rf.

item.title: Waiting for the Miracle to Come
item.description: On the feeling that the real life is still coming — and the bargain you strike with yourself by never fully committing.
